card.line: The Decapolis was a region of ten cities near the Sea of Galilee, where crowds followed Jesus and a healed man told everyone what Jesus had done.

moments.title: Crowds follow Jesus
moments.text: News about Jesus spread, and He healed many who were sick or suffering. Large crowds followed Him, including people from the Decapolis.

moments.title: A healed man tells his story
moments.text: Jesus told the man to go home and tell his people how much the Lord had done for him. He went and proclaimed it throughout the Decapolis, and everyone was amazed.

moments.title: A deaf man healed
moments.text: Jesus came into the region of the Decapolis, where people brought Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak. Jesus opened his ears and freed his tongue, and the people were utterly astonished.
